shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && rg --files app public | sort'
/bin/bash -lc "cat app/page.tsx && cat app/ProductGrid.tsx && cat app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && cat app/ProductSkeleton.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react');console.log(require('react/package.json').version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\" && rg -n 'transitionTypes|ViewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md | tail -20 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && cat lib/products.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json && rg -n '\"node_modules/react\"|\"node_modules/next\"|\"react\":|\"react-dom\":' package-lock.json | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A32 -B8 'transitionTypes' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-components/link.md | head -100; rg -n 'reactVersion|19\\.3|ViewTransition' node_modules/next/package.json node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head -40; npm view react version && npm view next@16.5.0-canary.18 peerDependencies --json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference | rg '/link\\.md"'$|use-router'"\\.md"'$'"' && node -p \"require('next/package.json').version\" && npm view @types/react version && npm view @types/react-dom version"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,160p' app/PageTransition.tsx && sed -n '1,120p' app/page.tsx && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules | rg '("'^|/)(playwright|puppeteer)(/|$)'"' | head -30; which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true; rg -n 'view-transition-class|::view-transition' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md | tail -20"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/gallery-detail.html -w 'detail status: %{http_code}; bytes: %{size_download}; time: %{time_total}\\n' http://localhost:3100/product/classic-sneakers && rg -o 'product-image-classic-sneakers|Back to products|skeleton-text|Classic Sneakers' /tmp/gallery-detail.html | sort | uniq -c"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && npm ls react react-dom @types/react @types/react-dom --depth=0'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la | head -40 && if test -f .gitignore; then cat .gitignore; fi'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import mkdtemp
from shutil import move
root = Path('/workspace')
artifacts = ('.next', 'next-env.d.ts', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo')
destination = Path(mkdtemp(prefix='gallery-build-artifacts-'))
for name in artifacts:
    path = root / name
    if path.exists() and path.parent == root:
        move(str(path), str(destination / name))
print(destination)
PY"
